annotations.title: Create or change a table of contents style

description: Create a table of contents style (Inhaltsverzeichnisformat) or change the one with the same name: title (heading of the TOC, "" for none), title_style, entries[] in TOC order – each {paragraph_style (paragraphs with this style become entries), level (1 = top, default 1), entry_style (paragraph style for the entry), page_number_position after (default) | before | none, separator (between entry text and page number, e.g. "^t" for a tab), page_number_style, separator_style, sort_alphabetical}. entries replaces all entries of an existing style; a new style needs entries. include_hidden_layers, run_in (lowest level on one line), create_bookmarks (PDF bookmarks). Every named style must exist (not_found; create them with define_paragraph_style / define_character_style). remove true deletes the style. Returns created, updated, removed and toc_style (as list_toc_styles). Then call create_toc.

create_bookmarks.description: Create PDF bookmarks from the entries.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

entries.description: Entries in TOC order; replaces all entries of an existing style.

entry_style.description: Paragraph style of the entry in the TOC.

level.description: Level in the TOC, 1 = top. Default 1.

page_number_position.description: Page number after the entry (default), before it or none.

page_number_style.description: Character style for the page number.

paragraph_style.description: Paragraph style whose paragraphs become entries.

separator.description: Characters between entry text and page number, InDesign metacharacters allowed (e.g. "^t" tab).

sort_alphabetical.description: Sort the entries of this level alphabetically.

name.description: Name of the TOC style, exact.

remove.description: Delete the TOC style named name.

run_in.description: Run the lowest level into one paragraph.

title.description: Title above the TOC; "" for none.
